material.description: git_pull was refused as long-gap-no-instruction (executor drain-gm-4, after dispatch 1792906578323-5331-b923e9fe52e1511f panicked). The gate is cleared by a successful instruction dispatch, and instruction panics on the served build, so every consolidation pull is blocked until the served build carries the fix. Expected: a failed instruction dispatch should not leave the pull gate closed, or the gate should accept another proof of recent instruction. Witness: with instruction panicking, git_pull on /workspace/gm is refused by the gate, not by local changes.
material.subject: long-gap-no-instruction gate refuses git_pull while the instruction verb itself panics
material.witness: instruction dispatch 1792913744978-5257-64da8228e4749c86 returned ok, then git_pull origin main ff_only from cwd /workspace/oscraft, session verify-gm-pull-gate-deadlocks-on-instruction-panic, answered in 1000 ms with already_up_to_date and no conflict. No instruction error was induced, so this shows the gate answers after an instruction call, not the induced-error case the row named; served runner 0.1.2104.
